title: Reuse parsed strict payloads for mismatch diagnostics
body:
## Summary

PR2693 reparses both JSON inputs after a proof-relevant mismatch. This opt-in successor reuses the parsed values while preserving PR2040's tree evaluation order, invalid-input fallback and complete diagnostics.

```diff
- paired mismatch -> decompress and parse both again -> original diagnostics
+ paired mismatch -> original diagnostics on already parsed values
```

The new package is `research/strict-payload-negative-reuse`. It includes a registered replay, exact source pins, controls, benchmark and scope. Frozen callers, scientific inputs and the selected frontier remain unchanged.

## Evidence

- **Before:** four parses and four decompressions on a compressed mismatch. **After:** two of each with the same literal typed diagnostic.
- All 1,012 retained full-result differential comparisons and both canonical receipts agree. All 18 control groups pass in registered CPython 3.12.15 replay and optimized Python 3.14, including the actual CLI, source/manifest drift, timing policy and invalid-sibling precedence.
- Three rotating-order trials on the same five largest compressed files: sum of per-file median times 7.403s to 6.073s, **1.219x over PR2693**, on macOS 27.0.1 arm64. PR2040 directly takes 6.149s; no improvement over that classifier is claimed. Three files share an identical inherited template. This is a fixed added-field mismatch workload, not a full-replay speedup or performance threshold.
- Independent internal review caught a retained-test module alias error, corrected before the final tests. No remaining finding or independent human review is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/strict-payload-negative-reuse
python3.14 -I -O -B research/strict-payload-negative-reuse/test_compare.py
python3.12 -I -B research/strict-payload-negative-reuse/benchmark.py --rounds 3 --out /tmp/negative-reuse-benchmark.json
```

Started from canonical main `d3add2cc2`; checked against refreshed canonical main `991c50d1e` before submission. Priority revision 5, guidance and all 17 inputs remain unchanged. Refreshed overlap covered 472 open PRs, 1,622 Discussion records and 2,157 closed PRs with complete pagination, within the helper's documented search limits. [Canonical investigation and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2937).

Credit ywz65/PR2693 for paired traversal and this negative-path handoff; commdata2338/PR2040 for strict semantics and controls; Josie Elliston/PR1824 and the retained supplier/archive authors for the corpus. Detailed attribution is retained in the package. Substantial AI assistance was used; no independent human review is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** opt-in.

No default caller adopts this adapter. It retains the predecessor's trusted-local-input contract, inventory and integer limits; the separate PR2921/PR2803/PR2344 adapters are not composed here. Caller-specific adoption, other workloads, peak memory and hosted execution remain unverified. No supplier cold replay or new kappa is claimed.
